start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter padhenge—shape ke sabhi sides ka total. Aapko maths mein kya pasand hai?

turns.reply: Kabir, koi baat nahi. Sochiye, vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing lagani ho—fencing kitni doori tak lagegi, aap kaise pata karenge?
Kabir, sawaal galat fit tha—ab seedha: perimeter matlab polygon ki har side ko jodna. Chaar sides 3, 4, 5, 6 hon, total kya hoga?
Kabir, aapko ye part boring lag raha hai—chaliye format badalte hain: game, picture, ya quick challenge? Aap choose kijiye.
Theek hai, Kabir. Rani 50 m by 30 m park ke 3 rounds daudti hain. Pehle aap kya nikaalenge?

turns.line: mujhe gussa aa raha hai, ye samajh nahi aa raha
turns.reply: Kabir, gussa side mein rakhte hain: ek round mein 50, 30, 50, 30 jodna hai. Aapka pehla total kya aayega?
Thoda paani pi lijiye aur aaraam kijiye.
Bilkul, 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, perimeter 160 m. Ab isi tareeke se square ki chaar equal sides ka perimeter kaise likhenge?

turns.board: Rani runs 3 rounds of a rectangular park 50 m long and 30 m wide. How far does she run? · 3 × 160 = ___ m.
turns.reply: Haan Kabir, main ek AI teacher hoon—robot jaisi technology se kaam karti hoon. Aapka mazaak samajh aaya; ab maths par dhyaan dete hain. Khaali jagah bhariye: 3 × 160 = ___ m.
